pages.title: Number Theory
pages.text: $(thing)Number Theory$()$(br2)Primes, modular forms and the Riemann zeta function - the hardest problems in mathematics are about whole numbers.

$(thing)Insight$(): 40$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Primes, Modular Arithmetic, Complex Analysis.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 16 Prime Shard.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Every whole number factors into primes in exactly one way. Use that to rewrite the series of 1/nˢ over all positive integers as a product, one factor for each prime p_k, where each factor is the geometric series of all powers of that prime.
